messages:
Priya: quick heads-up: microquant canary in staging is producing funcall arg corruption. ~2.3% of samples (5k) show escaped sequences becoming literal control chars in tool args which breaks downstream callers.

Priya: example captured output: {"tool":"notify","args":{"msg":"Hello\nAlice"}} but some traces deliver the body with an actual newline character instead of the escape.

Sam: sounds like a streaming-frame cut splitting the escape token due to tokenization shifts in quant.

Ava: baseline fp16 was ~0.02% for this class, so it's a clear regression correlated to the quant variant.

Marta: biggest risk is silent corruption for side-effectful tools. If the JSON parses we won't trigger retries and tools can run with bad params.

Sam: proposed mitigations: 1) lightweight validator in postprocess that scans tool arg strings for non-printable controls (except 
 and 	) and quarantines responses for side-effect tools; 2) add idempotency tokens and a tool manifest with side_effect true/false; 3) instrument token-cut positions and raw chunk hex for telemetry.

Priya: operational plan: run offline eval of 20k historical funcall prompts through model tonight to build quarantine/repair taxonomy. If quarantine rate >1% for critical tools we hold the canary.

Marta: I'll add telemetry dims: model_variant, parsed_ok, quarantined, repaired, repair_type, tool_name, tool_side_effect, invoked_flag, idempotency_key, token_cut_index and wire alerts (quarantine rate >0.5% in 5m -> hold).

Sam: implementation note: keep validator out of hot serving path — implement in postprocess. If quarantined, return structured error code TOOL_QUARANTINED and do not invoke the tool. Persist original raw output for audit.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `microq-arg-validator-quarantine-v1` -> staging. CI: 3/4 checks passing.

Priya: scheduling a 50/50 A/B at 09:30 PT with quarantine-on for canary. Will post offline eval CSV and follow-up summary.

Ava: :thumbsup:
